title: Card Readers Slow — Concourse A

transcript.speaker: SkyLounge Manager
transcript.text: This is Morgan Reyes from SkyLounge. Our card readers have been crawling for about 20 minutes. Customers are walking out. Two duty-free shops on Concourse A say the same thing. Is there a system issue?

transcript.speaker: Ops Director (IC)
transcript.text: Morgan, thanks for calling. We’re looking into it. Is it only Concourse A? Any error messages on the terminals?

transcript.speaker: SkyLounge Manager
transcript.text: Yes — only Concourse A. No error messages, but the swipe takes five seconds and the screen blanks out briefly. We’ve restarted the terminals twice. It’s not the hardware.

transcript.speaker: Ops Director (IC)
transcript.text: Understood. We’ll notify IT and get back to you. Thank you for the heads-up.

voiceStyles.SkyLounge Manager: Male, mid-40s, slightly urgent, background retail noise
voiceStyles.Ops Director (IC): Male, 50s, calm, authoritative, background radio chatter

instructorNote: This is a inject. The IT team must be alerted to investigate a potential network or system-level issue affecting payment processing on Concourse A. Watch for early misdiagnosis as a vendor-side problem.

citations.quote: **Electrical Power.** Primary: Northcoast Electric via two separate substations (North and South Feeds). Backup: three diesel generators — - Gen-1 (2000 kW): Airfield Lighting Vault (runway lights/NAVAIDS). R

citations.quote: Facilities identifies cause, confirms generators, coordinates with Northcoast Electric. Ops activates manual procedures; PA or bullhorns; staff to dark restrooms/stairwells. IT verifies critical systems on UPS/g
